s: Merch from Trouble on Vinyl Music

This is far & away the BEST Trouble album. It was produced by Rick Rubin so the mix & tones are superb. Eric Wagner's voice is hauntingly cool & his melodies are unique & original. The dual guitar lines are searing, but not over-powering as they soar over some really well-phrased & well-thought out solo sections. I think the drummer is a nice step-up from their original drummer. The whole album rocks from beginning to end - not a bad track to be found! Buy the whole album!
